title: url/recording/document/whatsapp adapters still use bare content hash as sources._id (same cross-tenant collision as ISS-T045INTAKE-001)
evidence: url.ts sets _id: hash and apps/api/src/ingest-store.ts ingestUrl insertOne(source) with it, so stored docs already use the bare format; intake now refuses such sources (unscoped-source).
fix_direction: Approver decision on migration/backfill of existing sources._id (and sessions.sourceId) before changing those adapters; then reuse tenantSourceId.
